## Why This Is Asked
Tests ability to implement per-tenant isolation, security controls, and CI/CD validation in a real Azure SQL setup.

## Key Concepts
- Zero-trust with per-tenant isolation
- Row-Level Security and USER_CONTEXT()
- Managed Identities and least privilege
- Dynamic data masking and SQL auditing
- CI/CD policy checks and automated tests

## Code Example
```sql
CREATE FUNCTION dbo.fnTenantPredicate(@TenantId int)
RETURNS TABLE
WITH SCHEMABINDING
AS RETURN SELECT 1 AS access WHERE @TenantId = CAST(USER_CONTEXT(N'TenantId') AS int);

CREATE SECURITY POLICY dbo.TenantPolicy
ADD FILTER PREDICATE dbo.fnTenantPredicate(TenantId) ON dbo.YourTable,
ADD BLOCK PREDICATE dbo.fnTenantPredicate(TenantId) ON dbo.YourTable;
```

## Why This Is Asked

Tests ability to design dynamic, per-tenant access controls that operate at query time, integrating multiple Azure services (Cosmos DB, Redis, Synapse Serverless, Delta Lake, Purview). It also probes upgrade strategies, versioning, and auditing across a data lake.

## Key Concepts

- Dynamic Row-Level Security in Azure Synapse Serverless
- Centralized policy store with versioning (Cosmos DB)
- Per-tenant caching (Redis) and cache invalidation
- Predicate injection into Delta Lake queries
- Auditing and masking (Purview) with testability

## Code Example

```sql
-- Pseudo-SQL illustrating a security policy setup
CREATE SECURITY POLICY dbo.TenantRLS
ADD BLOCK PREDICATE dbo.fn_TenantPredicate() ON dbo.Observations
WITH (STATE = ON);
```

## Follow-up Questions

- How would you test policy upgrades without downtime across tenants?
- How would you handle policy revocation and backfills in historical data?
